verdict.rationale: Brevo documents an MCP integration that lets AI assistants interact with the account, explicitly covering campaigns and contacts. Its API supports organizing contact lists programmatically and exporting 7 days of raw transactional events for analytics. That covers audiences and some reporting data, but there is no evidence that an agent can read live automation workflows or pull marketing campaign performance results. Missing for 10: programmatic read access to live automations/workflows, documented campaign-results/statistics retrieval via API or MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
Export raw data of all transactional events from the past 7 days. Generate reports with unaggregated data for analytics.
